classification.difficultyReason: Choose an order for linked deductions using marked parallel lines, straight or vertically opposite angles, and triangle sums. The harder diagrams require recovering an intermediate angle and carrying it into another triangle or parallel-line relationship, with no new construction needed.

content.prompt: Find $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\theta$ in these diagrams, giving reasons.

spec.description: Parallelogram CARD with diagonal DA; single arrows on CA and DR and double arrows on CD and AR. Ordinary source-blue strokes become black.
spec.mathematics: CA parallel DR; CD parallel AR; CAD=28 degrees; CDA=58 degrees. Unknowns DAR, ADR and ARD.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown symbols appear.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=58^\circ$ (alternate angles, $AR\parallel CD$).

$\beta=28^\circ$ (alternate angles, $CA\parallel DR$).

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+58^\circ+28^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=94^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle ADR$.

spec.description: Quadrilateral FGHI with diagonal FH and matching arrows on FI and GH.
spec.mathematics: FI parallel GH; GFH=64 degrees; FGH=66 degrees; FIH=120 degrees. Unknowns IFH, FHG and IHF.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+64^\circ+66^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles, $FI\parallel GH$.

$\beta=50^\circ$ (alternate angles, $FI\parallel GH$).

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+50^\circ+120^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=10^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle FIH$.

spec.description: Triangle SOR with E extending SR leftwards and ray OH extending left; matching horizontal parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: HO parallel SR; HOS=30 degrees; SRO=75 degrees. Unknowns SOR and OSR.
spec.answerVisibility: Only givens and alpha/theta labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\theta=30^\circ$ (alternate angles, $HO\parallel SR$).

$$\begin{align*}\alpha+30^\circ+75^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=75^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle SOR$.

spec.description: Parallelogram PLAY with diagonal PA, single arrows on horizontal sides and double arrows on the other opposite sides.
spec.mathematics: PL parallel YA; PY parallel LA; PLA=65 degrees; YAP=55 degrees. Unknowns LPA, APY and PAL.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=55^\circ$ (alternate angles, $PL\parallel YA$).

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+55^\circ+65^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle PLA$.

$\beta=60^\circ$ (alternate angles, $PY\parallel LA$).

spec.description: Triangle AIR, with complete collinear extensions V-I-R-T and L-A-U, and matching parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: VIRT parallel LAU; VIA=125 degrees; IAR=70 degrees. Unknowns IRA and RAU.

answer.short:
$\theta=55^\circ$, $\beta=55^\circ$.

Use a straight angle, the triangle angle sum and alternate angles.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle AIR+125^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle AIR&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
Straight angle $VIR$.

$$\begin{align*}\theta+70^\circ+55^\circ&=180^\circ\\\theta&=55^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle AIR$.

$\beta=55^\circ$ (alternate angles, $IR\parallel AU$).

spec.description: Crossed segments FWI and GWT between parallel horizontal segments FG and TI.
spec.mathematics: FG parallel TI; FGW=42 degrees; GWI=100 degrees. Unknowns GFW, TIW and WTI.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the printed 42 and 100 degree givens appear.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle FWG+100^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle FWG&=80^\circ\end{align*}$$
Straight angle $FWI$.

$$\begin{align*}\alpha+42^\circ+80^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=58^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle FGW$.

$\beta=58^\circ$ (alternate angles, $FG\parallel TI$).

$\gamma=42^\circ$ (alternate angles, $FG\parallel TI$).

spec.description: Quadrilateral TRAP with diagonal PR, parallel marks on TR and PA and a right-angle square at T.
spec.mathematics: TR parallel PA; PTR=90 degrees; TRP=36 degrees; PAR=54 degrees. Unknowns RPA, TPR and PRA.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=36^\circ$ (alternate angles, $TR\parallel PA$).

$$\begin{align*}\beta+90^\circ+36^\circ&=180^\circ\\\beta&=54^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle PTR$.

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+36^\circ+54^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=90^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle PRA$.

spec.description: Segments MAR and SAT intersect at A between parallel vertical segments SM and RT. Alpha labels the upper angle at A.
spec.mathematics: SM parallel RT; SMA=68 degrees; SAM=28 degrees. Unknowns SAR, ART and ATR.
spec.answerVisibility: Only printed givens and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\alpha+28^\circ&=180^\circ\\\alpha&=152^\circ\end{align*}$$
Straight angle $MAR$.

$\beta=68^\circ$ (alternate angles, $SM\parallel RT$).

$\angle RAT=28^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles at $A$).

$$\begin{align*}\gamma+68^\circ+28^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=84^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angle sum of $\triangle ART$.
